metadata.title: Stoquify Analytics and Controlled-Network Phases 0–3 Work Package Registry

program.objective: Create recurring evidence-backed analytical value, then prove safe repeat participation through controlled accountant, supplier, customer, and implementation-partner loops.
program.north_star: Monthly organizations completing at least one evidence-backed operating decision and one trusted external-participation outcome without a critical control breach.

phases.name: Foundation and control closure
phases.outcome: One approved semantic, access, evidence, and external-readiness foundation.

phases.name: Three decision surfaces
phases.outcome: Decision-grade cash, reconciliation, and accountant advisory analytics with no new write authority.

phases.name: Participation analytics and pilot readiness
phases.outcome: Privacy-bounded participation measurement and rehearsed external operations.

phases.name: Closed network pilot
phases.target_weeks: 33-46 with up to four readout weeks
phases.outcome: Evidence-backed decision to exit, revise, expand a controlled network, or stop.

streams.name: Data semantics, BI contracts, and instrumentation
Access, entitlement, privacy, and abuse controls

milestones.name: Program baseline accepted
milestones.evidence: Approved decision register, scope, capacity, and baseline metrics.

milestones.name: Shared analytics contract usable
milestones.evidence: Contract, robust-state, isolation, localization, and accessibility checks.

milestones.name: Reconciliation executive mode internal beta
milestones.evidence: Source tie-out, permissions, component/browser, and task-completion evidence.

milestones.name: 13-week Cash Command internal beta
milestones.evidence: Weekly bucket tie-out, double-count controls, and UX evidence.

milestones.name: Accountant Advisory internal beta and Phase 1 gate
milestones.evidence: Per-row grant, cross-currency, usability, and G1 evidence.

milestones.name: Participation and external-operations rehearsal complete
milestones.evidence: Signed provider, privacy, abuse, support, real-cohort, and kill-switch packet.

milestones.name: Pilot exit decision
milestones.evidence: Independent data/control review and executive decision.

work_packages.title: Program baseline and decision register
acceptance_criteria: Every assumption has an owner and due date
Open-marketplace scope is explicitly excluded
Capacity and pilot boundary are approved

work_packages.title: Surface ownership and duplication map
acceptance_criteria: Every target job has one canonical surface
Every KPI has one semantic owner
No new generic overview route is approved

work_packages.title: Organization money, timezone, and period contract
acceptance_criteria: No target metric depends on a hard-coded XAF assumption
Day boundaries derive from approved organization timezone
All monetary totals use fixed-precision source aggregation
rollback: Show blocked state when context is missing

work_packages.title: Metric registry and semantic ownership
acceptance_criteria: Every Phase 1 metric has a source owner
Exposure and loss are separate semantics
Cross-currency aggregation rules are explicit
verification: Finance, Accounting, Payments, Product, and Data sign-off
rollback: Display blocker instead of substituting a value

work_packages.title: Participation event taxonomy
acceptance_criteria: Issued, queued, delivered, failed, clicked, accepted, activated, first-value, retained, expanded, revoked, and abuse-blocked are distinct
All events have idempotent source keys
Recipient PII is excluded from aggregate contracts

work_packages.title: Pilot access and entitlement closure
acceptance_criteria: Zero unexplained pilot-scope inventory finding
All sensitive checks are server-side
Revoked grants, disabled modules, expired tokens, and cross-tenant access fail closed

work_packages.title: Shared evidence and read-model contract
acceptance_criteria: All target models implement the same evidence envelope
Blocked and degraded data cannot masquerade as trusted
All action links are permission aware

work_packages.title: Delivery, consent, abuse, and retention plan
acceptance_criteria: Every lane has a purpose, consent, expiry, revocation, retry, suppression, and support owner
Supplier invitation delivery gap has an explicit decision
Outbound can be disabled independently from internal analytics

work_packages.title: Phase 0 foundation gate
acceptance_criteria: No unresolved critical semantic, access, evidence, or external-control decision
Phase 1 capacity is committed

work_packages.title: Shared analytical foundation
acceptance_criteria: All three target screens can consume one evidence contract
Stale, partial, blocked, empty, and denied states are testable
No client-side authorization dependency

work_packages.title: CashForecastCommandReadModel v1
acceptance_criteria: Every bucket reconciles to traceable source facts
Double counting is prevented
No saved scenario write authority
Person-level payroll is redacted

work_packages.title: Cash Command decision UX and instrumentation
acceptance_criteria: First viewport answers runway, deficit, drivers, coverage, and next actions
All robust states render
EN/FR and accessible interaction pass

work_packages.title: ReconciliationLeakageReadModel v1
acceptance_criteria: Totals reconcile to authoritative runs and suspense
Root-cause taxonomy is exhaustive or visibly unknown
Unresolved exposure is never labeled loss
rollback: Keep existing Payment Reconciliation workbench authoritative

work_packages.title: Reconciliation executive mode and instrumentation
acceptance_criteria: Executive mode adds no override capability
Read, override, sign, and export permissions remain separate
All robust and accessible states pass

work_packages.title: AccountantAdvisoryPortfolioReadModel v1
acceptance_criteria: Every row is re-authorized against an active grant
Firm totals use counts and bands, not cross-currency sums
Revocation and expiry remove access immediately

work_packages.title: Accountant advisory UX and internal beta
acceptance_criteria: Accountants can identify and open the highest-priority permitted client
Exports remain scope-limited and watermarked
No raw recipient PII appears in growth summaries

work_packages.title: Phase 1 product-value gate
acceptance_criteria: Correctness, access, evidence, performance, accessibility, and instrumentation pass
Internal/design-partner task completion demonstrates recurring value

work_packages.title: ParticipationFunnelReadModel cohorts
acceptance_criteria: Unique-human and unique-organization denominators are explicit
Late and replayed events are deterministic
Sensitive breakdowns suppress below threshold

work_packages.title: Delivery health and outbox operations
acceptance_criteria: Statement and accountant paths are provider-proven
Supplier delivery is connected or pilot-disabled
Every dispatch has reconstructable state
Independent kill switches work

work_packages.title: First trusted value and retained activation
acceptance_criteria: Milestone traces to an evidence-backed event
Test/seed/internal cohorts are excluded
Metric cannot be satisfied by invite or click alone

work_packages.title: Lane effectiveness and no-rekey metrics
acceptance_criteria: External proposals/requests are not counted as authoritative outcomes
No raw PII appears in the growth view
Every metric ties to a source event

work_packages.title: Privacy, consent, abuse, and retention controls
acceptance_criteria: Consent purpose is recorded and enforced
Revocation and expiry are timely
Sensitive cohorts suppress below threshold
Abuse can be stopped per tenant/channel

work_packages.title: Support, incident, and participant operations
acceptance_criteria: Every lane has a duty owner and escalation
Wrong-recipient and consent disputes are rehearsed
Support capacity covers cohort limits

work_packages.title: End-to-end closed-pilot rehearsal
acceptance_criteria: No waived critical failure
Every lane has successful and fail-closed evidence
Operators can execute the kill switch and recovery plan

work_packages.title: Phase 2 pilot-ready gate
acceptance_criteria: All G2 criteria pass
Real cohort and stop thresholds are approved
Production credentials are not used before approval

work_packages.title: Cohort governance and launch control
acceptance_criteria: Every participant and lane is allowlisted
Start/end dates, limits, support, baseline, and stop thresholds are signed
No public discovery is enabled
verification: Preflight signed by Product, Security, Privacy, SRE, Support, and domain control owner

work_packages.title: Accountant client-network lane
acceptance_criteria: All client access is consented and per-row authorized
Growth metrics remain aggregate or banded
Revocation SLA is met
rollback: Disable invite channel and tenant cohort

work_packages.title: Supplier participation lane
acceptance_criteria: Supplier responses remain proposals
Buyer review remains mandatory
No public profile or rating
Token and duplicate controls pass

work_packages.title: Customer statement self-service lane
acceptance_criteria: Transactional consent is not reused for marketing
Tokens expire and revoke
Wrong-recipient response is operational
Recipient access remains purpose-bound

work_packages.title: Implementation partner and template lane
acceptance_criteria: No commissions, lead marketplace, or public discovery
Partner access exposes no cross-tenant client data
Attribution reaches first trusted value

work_packages.title: Weekly network operations and learning
acceptance_criteria: Every metric is segmented by lane and cohort version
Metric changes are versioned
Stop thresholds automatically create a decision
rollback: Pause affected lane when stop threshold is hit

work_packages.title: Exit, expand, revise, or stop decision
acceptance_criteria: Decision uses retained trusted value rather than invite volume
Independent data and controls review is complete
Expansion cannot introduce marketplace scope without a new program

risks.name: money_time_period_misstatement
risks.control: organization analytical context and cutoff tests

risks.name: exposure_presented_as_proven_loss
risks.control: metric vocabulary and UI claim gate

risks.name: surface_inventory_false_confidence
risks.control: reconcile scanner and live route/action/API truth

risks.name: gamed_or_polluted_referral_metrics
risks.control: source keys, exclusions, quality flags, trusted-value milestone

risks.name: tenant_supplier_mistaken_for_shared_identity
risks.control: invitation-scoped identity and no public rating

risks.name: marketplace_scope_creep
risks.control: explicit exclusions and new-program change control

packaging.cash_forecast: Finance/Analytics value layer conditional on source entitlements
packaging.reconciliation_executive: Part of Payment Reconciliation with existing evidence/export boundaries
packaging.accountant_advisory: Accounting-firm add-on by active consented-client band
packaging.external_collaboration: Controlled invitations with fair-use limits during pilot and no transaction take rate
